projects.s3ntry.md: s3ntry - ci/cd + monitoring for alexandria. self-hosted runner, ci gate, rollback path, go health daemon (goroutine per service) -> slack/discord alerts + live status page. mean alert 5.7s over 5 failure trials.
projects.ledgr.md: ledgr - double-entry personal finance. immutable entries, idempotent posts, hsbc pdf + revolut parsers that self-check against printed totals, staged review before posting, stats by category + month. fastapi + sqlite, live on fly.io.
projects.1337.md: 1337 - neetcode spaced-repetition tracker. claude and i's - vibecoded, used daily. flask + react, daily digest emails.
projects.sherpa.md: sherpa - google student ai hackathon, team of 6. gemini career dashboard for students. i built the latex cv generator + the dashboard redesign.
projects.recurse.md: re::curse - daily interview prep emails via gemini. questions at 11, solutions at 23.
projects.educhain.md: educhain - easya x algorand hackathon. credential verification on algorand, with an nft per credential. first coding hackathon: i mostly learned the team's code and got it deployed. repo.
projects.cr1ms0nfin.md: cr1ms0nfin - oled black + red theme for jellyfin 12. one block of css variables beats every built-in theme, the rest swaps out the stock blue hard-coded into sliders, switches and spinners. square corners, mono details, section titles as // comments, a $ sign-in prompt, cards that lift into red corner brackets. the spinning circle becomes a square terminal spinner. an optional script adds a hero banner (what you were watching, else the next episode you're partway through, else an unwatched pick), a status line when you pause, a volume readout (desktop browsers get none from jellyfin) and s01e03 episode numbers, and themes the dashboard, which jellyfin keeps custom css off. repo.
projects.cybersoc-ig.md: cybersoc-ig - instagram post + story templates for kcl cybersoc, black on white, terminal style. six layouts (ascii shield, man page, nmap, xxd, boot log, git diff); [word] inverts, *word* bolds, export straight to png. a share link carries the whole post in the url. no build step. use it · repo.
projects.cmatrix-saver.md: cmatrix-saver - cmatrix screensaver for gnome on wayland. 5 min idle -> fullscreen kitty on every monitor, decrypt title, then cmatrix, pipes or one of ten python scenes (a snake that steers itself to the nearest %, self-playing tetris and pong, life, maze + a*, sorting, boids, langton's ant, plasma, eca), each game ending in a dissolve into the next, under a tmux status bar on the main monitor. keys (pause, speed, colour, next scene) hit every monitor at once; anything else closes it. a claude code hook lists sessions that finished or need input since it came up. repo.
projects.redline.md: redline - tmux-style top bar for gnome. a tag block with what's next today (my planner, or gnome calendar for everyone else), workspaces as tmux windows, the focused window, now playing, and alerts that only show up when they matter: cpu/mem when high, device batteries, red live / rec / mic off. tested in a headless gnome shell against fake upower, mpris and calendar servers. repo.
projects.mosaic.md: mosaic - obs scenes, but small, for gnome on wayland. pick windows through the screencast portal, drag them onto a 1920x1080 stage, save layouts and flip between them, share one clean output window in meet. frames stay on the gpu (dma-buf straight into gtk), off-stage windows pause, and a tiny gnome shell extension names captures by matching thumbnails, since the portal never says what you picked. python + gtk4 + gstreamer. repo.
projects.inkpad.md: inkpad - mini onenote for tutoring. write on the ipad with the pencil, it shows up live on the laptop i'm screensharing, mid-stroke. stdlib python server + one html page, server-sent events. import a pptx and annotate each slide with room around it. runs in docker on alexandria. repo.
projects.modul0.md: modul0 - this site. astro + react. you found the terminal. named after the % operator: man modul0.
